title: MATK: The Meme Analytical Tool Kit

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal models on datasets annotated for discriminatory content and attack types targeting protected categories (e.g., Facebook's Hateful Memes and Fine-Grained Hateful Memes).

Evaluating models using the Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification dataset, which annotates memes for multiple aspects of hatred towards women, including misogyny, shaming, stereotypes, and objectification.

Applying post-hoc interpretability techniques (LIME) to detect whether specific sensitive visual objects (e.g., 'Arab') or text combinations inappropriately trigger false positive hateful classifications.
